CLASS Course
    ATTRIBUTES:
        courseId
        courseName

CLASS Student
    ATTRIBUTES:
        studentId
        studentName

CLASS CollegeRegistration
    ATTRIBUTE:
        registrations = Map<Course, List<Student>>

    METHOD register(course, student)
        IF course not in registrations
            registrations[course] = new empty List<Student>
        registrations[course].add(student)

    METHOD display()
        FOR each entry in registrations
            course = entry.key
            studentList = entry.value
            PRINT "Course: " + course.courseName
            FOR each student in studentList
                PRINT "   Student: " + student.studentName

MAIN:
    CREATE regSystem = new CollegeRegistration()

    c1 = new Course("CSE101", "DSA")
    c2 = new Course("CSE102", "AI")

    s1 = new Student("101", "Alice")
    s2 = new Student("102", "Bob")
    s3 = new Student("103", "Charlie")

    regSystem.register(c1, s1)
    regSystem.register(c1, s2)
    regSystem.register(c2, s3)

    regSystem.display()
    END MAIN
END CLASS
